headline: CMS INDUSLAW advises ITC Hotels on acquisition of Welcomhotel, Ahmedabad
sum: ITC Hotels Limited is set to make a 100% acquisition of GHK Hospitality & Infrastructures Limited, which owns Welcomhotel, Ahmedabad. CMS INDUSLAW advised ITC Hotels on this acquisition.
detail: ITC Hotels Limited is set to make a 100% acquisition of GHK Hospitality & Infrastructures Limited, which owns Welcomhotel, Ahmedabad. CMS INDUSLAW advised ITC Hotels on this acquisition. The transaction team consisted of Shantanu Jindel (Partner), Shweta Gupta (Partner), Associates Aanshavi Srishti, Abhinav A, Suryanshu Mishra and Samarth Jain. The Corporate Secretarial team, which advised on the due diligence aspects of the transaction, comprised Ruhi Jain (Executive Director) and Akshay Madhvani (Assistant Manager).
